text:
Jamal: Quick heads-up — we're planning a breaking change to /v1/generate: removing `legacy_text` in responses and the default model will switch from redwood-text-1 -> redwood-text-2 in ~6 weeks. Posting deprecation timeline + migration options. Please read & react if you own SDKs or clients.
Alex: Is there an Accept-Version header we can use to lock behavior? If not, what's recommended?
Jamal: We're going to support `Accept-RW-Version: 2026-03` (server-side negotiation). Default behavior will be the new model when the deprecation date passes and no header is present. Clients can send `Accept-RW-Version: 2024-11` to opt into the old response shape for an initial 3-month grace.
Mona: SDKs — do we need a shim or should we auto-add header for older minor versions?
Jamal: Short answer: yes. For semver < 2.0.0 we'll add the header shim automatically in official SDKs for a 3-month window. We'll also expose a config flag to opt out.
Sara: What about streaming responses? Any change in chunk/event format?
Jamal: No change to event framing. The only change is a field rename in the chunk payload: `legacy_text` -> `text`. Streaming events will still use `event.name: "response.chunk"`. We'll keep a compatibility path for 3 months via the header/query param.
Priya: Some embedded platforms can't set custom headers. Can we support a query param fallback?
Alex: +1 for a query param fallback (easier for some CDN/iframe clients).
Jamal: Good call — we'll support `?compat=legacy` as query-param fallback. Precedence will be: header > query param > default behavior. Documented in the spec.
CI-bot: Deploy plan posted: https://deploys/redwood/changes/1234 — featureflag `rw-api-response-v2` enabled in staging.
Mona: Action items for SDK owners: 1) add header shim 2) expose opt-out config 3) bump minor version + release notes. I'll open PRs this week.
Jamal: Timeline (draft): announce now, docs + example PRs in 1 week, SDK shims merged in 2 weeks, staged rollout starts in 4 weeks, full cutover at 6 weeks. If any customer is blocked we can extend the window — ping me.
Sara: Can we emit telemetry to detect clients still reading `legacy_text` so we can notify them?
Jamal: Yes — we'll emit a `compat-readers.v1` metric when a response is consumed via the legacy shape (best-effort detection; include client_id if provided). I'll export top-20 clients list by week 5.
Alex: Thanks — I'll add router + e2e tests to assert both shapes and the header/query precedence.
Mona: Draft PRs: github.com/redwood/sdk/pulls/987 (shim) & github.com/redwood/docs/pulls/76 (docs).
Jamal: Thanks everyone. If no blockers I'll start writing the deprecation doc today and post a checklist. :thumbsup:
